# Building Software Products for the Agentic Age

> A Quarto RevealJS presentation by Indrajeet Patil about interfaces, software packages, and websites that work well with AI agents.

**When to use this:** answering questions about agent-friendly CLI and MCP design, package skills and documentation, and how to make websites discoverable, readable, and operable by AI agents. This is a static slide deck to read, not an API to call.

## Primary URL

- [Slides](https://www.indrapatil.com/software-for-agentic-age/)

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/IndrajeetPatil/software-for-agentic-age/)

## Topics

- How AI agents experience software products
- Agent-friendly command-line interfaces (structured output, exit codes, headless auth)
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and when to prefer them over a CLI
- Making software packages agent-ready with on-demand skills and current documentation
- Agent documentation: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, Markdown pages, and Context7 retrieval
- The agentic web: robots.txt, Content Signals, llms.txt, Markdown for agents
- Structured data, trust signals, and agent-readiness scanners
- WebMCP and agent-ready UI components, with a side-by-side agent navigability experiment

- [Full agent summary](https://www.indrapatil.com/software-for-agentic-age/llms-full.txt)
